limitations: Individual expert outputs are deterministic sampled replays through the deployed NVFP4 kernel, not BF16 comparisons.
Shared/routed components are measured after runtime routed scaling and after explicit TP reduction of diagnostic copies when required.
Pairwise cosine estimates with low sample counts remain noisy; JSON extrema require at least five samples and NPZ retains sums/counts.
Only sufficient statistics are stored; hidden vectors, prompts, routes and generated text are absent.
